title: Longest Substring with At Most Two Distinct Characters
summary: For the given text s, consider every contiguous segment and report the greatest length among segments that use no more than two different characters.
statement: For the given text s, consider every contiguous segment and report the greatest length among segments that use no more than two different characters.
constraints: 1–100000 English letters; uppercase and lowercase are different characters.
Find a contiguous substring with at most two distinct characters. Repeated occurrences of either character are allowed; one-character substrings also qualify.
target_space_complexity: O(1), at most three character counts
hints: The limit applies to distinct characters, not total window length or repeated occurrences.
Count characters in a window and shrink its left edge whenever a third distinct character enters.
Add the new right character; while there are more than two keys, decrement the left character and delete zero counts; update the largest width.
The shrink step may need several removals before a character count reaches zero.
editorial: A frequency map describes the current window. Expanding right may introduce a third distinct character; removing from the left restores the invariant. Each pointer advances at most n times, and at most three map entries exist during an update. The independent oracle enumerates substrings and measures the distinct-character set directly. Unlike the existing no-repeat exercise, arbitrarily many repetitions of the same two letters are allowed.

tests.explanation: The substring 'ece' has two distinct characters, e and c, and length 3 despite the repeated e.
The suffix 'aabbb' contains only a and b and has length 5.
